issues.description: `sys` is referenced in both mathimpl.py files without an `import sys` in the diff.
issues.detail: Both `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` add `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` but neither hunk adds `import sys`. If sys isn't already imported, this is a NameError at import time on every Python version. Verify and add the import where needed.

issues.description: Conditional registration in mathdecl.py is misplaced and rebinds `Math_unary` to the decorator result.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block is dedented to module scope without a blank-line separator, and `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` rebinds the class name to whatever `infer_global` returns. Use the decorator call as a bare statement, place it properly after the class block, and fix spacing.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idioms across three files for the same predicate.
issues.detail: Typing and impl files use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` while the test uses `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` from `numba.core.utils`. The codebase already standardizes on `PYVERSION`; use it everywhere, or alternatively `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` which tests the actual precondition rather than a Python-version proxy.

issues.description: Test inputs are copy-pasted from `test_exp` with duplicates and no exp2-specific edge cases.
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` contains duplicates, feeds negatives through unsigned types relying on unstated wraparound, and skips exp2-relevant cases (0, large powers, inf/nan, parity vs CPython `math.exp2`). Trim the duplicates and add a few targeted values.

issues.description: Release note file is missing a trailing newline and has a malformed/fragile RST underline.
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file` and the underline length does not match the title length, which some RST toolchains reject. The body also just restates the title. Add the newline, match the underline exactly, and tighten the prose.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously rejects the patch as submitted. Two P0 defects sink it: `sys` is used in both `mathimpl.py` files without a visible `import sys`, and the new conditional block in `mathdecl.py` is dedented to module scope while rebinding `Math_unary` to the decorator's return value rather than registering as a bare statement. Beyond that, three different version-gating idioms are sprinkled across the diff when `PYVERSION` (or `hasattr(math, 'exp2')`) already exists, the test values are a sloppy copy-paste from `test_exp` with duplicates and no exp2-specific edge cases, and the release note is missing a trailing newline with a malformed RST underline. Shape of the feature is right; execution needs another pass.
